command: npm run test:e2e -- --grep 'connections map supports controls' --repeat-each=3

environment.warmup: Every measured loop follows fit, button/keyboard/wheel/pinch boundary checks, resize preservation, ten incremental one-finger moves, capture transfer, pointercancel/lost-capture, pen where available, and drag-click suppression; no sample was discarded.

loop.event: modified WheelEvent through the same pure camera and rAF adapter used by pointer gestures

pointerEvidence.before: A touch pointer is implicitly captured by its hit-test descendant. Once the 6 px drag threshold transfers capture to the viewport, the descendant emits a bubbling lostpointercapture. The old viewport listener treated that descendant event as loss of its own capture and removed the active pointer, so later moves were ignored.
pointerEvidence.after: The viewport ignores only bubbling lostpointercapture whose event target is a descendant. It still clears state when the viewport itself loses capture. Ten 2 px/1.2 px incremental moves produced no camera write for the first two sub-threshold moves and one coalesced camera write for every subsequent move in both projects.

browserAssertions: 10% synchronizes output and native disabled zoom-out
200% synchronizes output and native disabled zoom-in
disabled controls compute pointer-events none and opacity 0.35
current card remains fully visible when minimum zoom cannot fit the full graph

bundleComparison.method: Same-host production builds at the branch point and working tree, using the same node_modules and gzip -c.

thresholds.policy: Timing is recorded evidence rather than a flaky CI gate. Deterministic bounds, cleanup, tree stability, and transform-write coalescing remain asserted in tests.

result: pass: continuous one-finger pan survives capture transfer, all cleanup paths end with zero active pointers, both zoom boundaries and native control state synchronize, every p95 is below 8 ms, no >50 ms Long Task was reported, and the node/edge geometry remained byte-for-byte unchanged during gestures.
